description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {0}.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Hangarback Walker from your library.
Repeat.
